currentExpectedOwnerValue.scopeStatus: OWNER_DEFINED_POLICY; no model/provider is selected, downloaded, licensed, qualified or available by this definition

automaticAcquisition.unavailableBehavior: return unsupported-or-unavailable; do not download a model, codec, plugin, font or asset automatically
explicitAdmissionRequires: exact artifact name and immutable version or digest
separate source-code, model-weight, dataset, patent, likeness and redistribution term review as applicable
named execution profile, locality and retention conditions
independent legal/security and runtime qualification approvals
automaticAcquisition.effect: This policy defines an eligibility gate only; it does not approve any candidate.

hardwareFootprintDoesNotWaiveAdmission.rule: A model or codec being small enough to fit available local RAM, disk, CPU, GPU, or an ONNX runtime package does not create an exception to artifact identity, source integrity, model-weight/license/terms review, security review, named-profile admission, privacy and locality checks, or independent runtime qualification.
hardwareFootprintDoesNotWaiveAdmission.localExecutionDisposition: DENY_UNADMITTED_MODEL; local hardware availability is a resource fact, not an admission, authority, compatibility, or qualification decision.
hardwareFootprintDoesNotWaiveAdmission.unknownDisposition: DENY; do not infer a model is safe, licensed, compatible, or approved from file size, format, or package presence.
hardwareFootprintDoesNotWaiveAdmission.scopeStatus: OWNER_DEFINED_POLICY; no model, codec, package, or runtime is admitted by this rule

fallback.localOnly: Cloud/provider egress is always denied for a local-only request or profile.
fallback.otherProfiles: Fallback may be considered only when an exact owner-approved profile explicitly lists the alternate provider/version and current consent, rights, locality, residency, retention, cost, quality/fidelity floor and security checks all pass.
fallback.failureBehavior: Do not download, substitute, or dispatch to another provider after unavailable, timeout, unknown outcome or policy error unless an exact pre-authorized fallback branch defines reconciliation and duplicate-effect behavior.
fallback.userDisclosure: Before a separately authorized fallback, surface the exact alternate provider/location, changed data handling, cost and fidelity consequences; otherwise fail closed.

nonClaims: No production-host download or cloud inference authorization
No admission, license, availability, quality, performance or scientific-fidelity claim

records.meaning: Hardware fit and local package presence cannot waive acquisition/admission/rights/privacy/security/profile/qualification gates. All prior DENY-default acquisition and fallback meanings are unchanged.

nonClaims: Any model acquisition or fallback approval
